description: This Java class 'Options' encapsulates command-line argument parsing for a bug report processing tool. It manages input files such as bugreport, monkey logs, logcat, and output html, providing methods to parse and validate command-line arguments, and exposing relevant configuration fields.

classes.description: A class to encapsulate command-line arguments for a bug report analysis tool, including parsing logic and fields for various input/output files.
